# Content patterns

Choose a pattern based on the reader's job. These are adaptable structures, not mandatory templates.

| Pattern | Best when the reader needs to… | Typical length |
|---|---|---|
| Landing page | Recognize what something is and decide whether to engage | Short |
| One-pager | Understand a topic or decision at a glance | One screen to a few screens |
| How-to guide | Complete a task correctly | As long as the task requires |
| Process explainer | Understand sequence, roles, and handoffs | Short to medium |
| Training guide | Learn and practice a capability | Modular |
| Technical explainer | Build a mental model of a technical concept | As long as needed |

Each pattern file explains the recommended reader path, useful components, and common mistakes.
